title: Mungaru Male 2
desc: Preetham, the son of Suryakanth, a millionaire, is driven by excitement and easily gets bored when it comes to relationships. He understands love after he meets Nandini.

title: Kshetrapati
desc: After his father's suicide, Basava embarks on a revolutionary journey in search of justice.

title: Bindaas
desc: Ajay, a young man, sets out to put an end to the conflict between two families that are connected by blood but have been enemies for several years.

title: Ayogya
desc: Siddhe Gowda, an unemployed young man, decides to run against Bachche Gowda, the village head, in the local election. He also begins to fall in love with Nandini, the daughter of a marriage broker.

title: Maurya
desc: Manu, a kick-boxer must train and win an upcoming tournament to fulfill his mother's wishes and to become the best in the world.
